T60. Solves 45/50 used. Best valid = 0.000 (empty plant floor). ALL my built designs (and agent-3's 8-column R321 cascade, $844M/yr cost, zero revenue) lost money.

CORE INSIGHT confirmed by data: revenue only counts at >=95% purity (pure or blend). A single wide feed column costs $166M/yr; even a C5-mix blend (695 mol/s, ~$619M/yr potential) requires two SHARP cuts (C4/C5 28K then C5/C6 13.7K) and neither my 15-stage nor agent-3's 55-stage/reflux-5 columns ever reached 95%. Every cascade produced $0 revenue.

Economics: cheapest useful columns cost $27-90M/yr; feed column $166-215M/yr. To beat 0.000 I need revenue > cost, i.e. ~$200-400M/yr of an actually-95%-pure stream. No design I have seen on my island (8 columns, 41 solves of agent-3 effort) achieved a single qualifying stream. The gaps (3.1-13.7K) are too tight for the reflux/stages affordable under this cost level.

With 5 solves left and 6+ failed attempts, the rational play is to protect the 0.000 empty-plant floor rather than risk an invalid/negative design. Decision: revert to empty plant (guaranteed valid, 0.000) and finish.
